notes.title: Ver. 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ver 1.2 update includes small but useful improvements, including hints that may help players in the third and forth levels.
[/b][/h3]

[b]Updates include: 
[/b]
Level 2
Added door enter arrow to improve compass room door discoverability

Level 3
Added door enter arrow (and purple glow) to improve compass room door discoverability

Level 3
Added new "zoom to hint targets" hint sign and functionality

Level 3 & 4
Decreased herb regen cooldown time in a few places (so herbs reappear sooner)

Level 4
Added hint arrow number indicators that help players know in which order they should attempt to fly to destinations

Plus small bug fixes

notes.title: Stand-alone demo "Ahro’s Dream", out Friday!
notes.content:
Eagle eyed viewers may have noticed we were previewing our demo, [i]Ahro’s Dream[/i] at MAGfest last weekend. So I'm happy to finally announce it! Our new short stand-alone demo [i]Ahro's Dream[/i], will be out this Friday, Feb. 2, 2024! 

I'm also excited to announce it will be part of Steam Next Fest, which run: Feb. 5 - 12, 2024! In addition to the new demo, we will be live streaming on Steam during Next Fest! More live stream info coming very soon, so keep an eye out for it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41513101/63f74b31051e05cfb5339e48d11cd1db3a263649.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Ahro was at MAGfest 2024!
notes.content:
Ahro was a fantastic success at the MAGfest Indie Game Showcase in Washington D. C. this past weekend! 

There was a sold out crowd of over 20,000 attendees! There were soooo many visitors at our booth, thank you all! 
We previewed our new upcoming demo, Ahro’s Dream! More info on the demo coming very very soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41513101/e04525fe82480b9339a10e5c266ebc04227281d4.jpg[/img]
